title: ThinkDIFFERENTLY About Disability Employment Act
committees: S-Small Business and Entrepreneurship Committee: Referred To 2025-06-04 || H-Small Business Committee: Referred To 2025-02-26 -> Markup By 2025-03-05 -> Reported By 2025-03-24
latest_action: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship.
summary: ThinkDIFFERENTLY About Disability Employment Act This bill requires the Small Business Administration (SBA) to (1) provide assistance to individuals with disabilities who desire to become entrepreneurs or to be self-employed, (2) help individuals with disabilities find employment at small businesses; and (3) assist small businesses with hiring such individuals and with accessibility issues applicable to such individuals. The SBA must conduct outreach and education about such activities. The bill establishes reporting requirements with respect to these activities.

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
